item.title: Reaction‐Driven Coupled Transport–Nanostructure Evolution in SnSb Anodes for High‐Energy All‐Solid‐State Li‐Ion Batteries
item.description:

Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a SnSb anode that undergoes reaction-driven coupled transport–nanostructure evolution, forming continuous mixed ionic–electronic conducting pathways and stabilized nanocrystallization during cycling. This suppresses pulverization, preserves SE contact, and lowers interfacial resistance. Significance: a SnSb|NCM811 full cell achieves 28.97 mAh cm⁻² at 200 mg cm⁻² loading, 1000-cycle 10 C stability, and projected 355.7 Wh kg⁻¹/1017.4 Wh L⁻¹, establishing a design principle for high-energy ASSLIB anodes.
🏷 all-solid-state battery · SnSb anode · Li6PS5Cl electrolyte · mixed conduction · nanostructure evolution

💡 The novelty lies in coupling a preconstructed In/Sb interfacial layer with a dynamic In³⁺ electrolyte additive, creating static-dynamic synergy that regenerates the interface during cycling. Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using micropore high-entropy single-atom carbon nanoparticles (CuNiMnCoIr/CNs) as an electrolyte additive to atomically regulate Zn deposition. It suppresses interfacial Zn²⁺ depletion and supersaturation by lowering migration barriers and homogenizing ion flux, enabling layer-by-layer growth. Significance: trace additive yields high transference number (0.89) and ultra-stable cycling (4000 h), advancing energy-dense aqueous metal batteries.

آند لایه نازک Ge روی جریان‌گردان توخالی carbon nanobox@Cu رسوب داده شد که با تعدیل هم‌افزای فصل مشترک، انتقال جرم و مکانیک، ظرفیت برگشت‌پذیر بیش از ۱۰۰۰ mAh g−1 و نرخ‌پذیری تا 10 A g−1 را فراهم می‌کند.
Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in depositing a Ge thin film on a hollow carbon nanobox@Cu current collector, enabling synergistic interface-mass-mechanical modulation. This design lowers electron tunneling barriers, improves conductivity, ensures electrolyte penetration, and accommodates volume expansion while preserving SEI integrity. The electrode exceeds 1000 mAh g⁻¹ and 10 A g⁻¹ rate capability, offering a strategy for high-performance thin-film anodes.
🏷 germanium anode · lithium-ion battery · carbon nanobox · volume expansion · thin-film anode

item.title: Pre‐Embedded CNTs Architecture Differentiates Carbon Functions for Kinetics Boosting in All‐Solid‐State Li–S Cathodes
item.description:
یک کاتد Li-S تمام‌جامد با چارچوب CNT از پیش جاسازی‌شده و تفکیک عملکردی کربن ساخته شد که انتقال بار را بهبود داده و ظرفیت ۱۴۳۸ mAh g−1 با حفظ ۹۱.۹٪ پس از ۴۰۰ چرخه ارائه می‌دهد.
Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a pre-embedded CNT framework that spatially separates carbon functions—KB for sulfur hosting/short-range transfer and CNTs as a long-range conducting skeleton—outperforming loading- and bridging-type designs. This yields 1438 mAh g⁻¹ at 1 C, 91.9% retention over 400 cycles, and 404 mAh g⁻¹ at 9 mg cm⁻², showing carbon functional differentiation mitigates kinetic barriers in all-solid-state Li–S cathodes.
🏷 all-solid-state Li-S · carbon nanotubes · cathode kinetics · Li6PS5Cl · charge transport
